english.meaning: just before leaving; at the point of going
english.note: Often used as 臨走嗰陣時, at the moment of leaving.

exampleSentences.english: Yip Hoi-ting cried when she was about to leave.
exampleSentences.traditional: 阿葉凱婷喊啊臨走嗰陣時。
